summary: Example of the shape a model review takes. The record's standard-of-care table runs from stage I to later-line metastatic disease in five rows, each carrying a guideline reference, and the stage II-III row names the KEYNOTE-522 and OlympiA regimens. The record-level source list is thin: only Wikipedia sits there, with the guideline links kept on the rows.

verdicts.claim: The standard-of-care table lists five rows, from stage I to later-line metastatic disease.
verdicts.note: Five settings are listed: stage I, stage II-III, two first-line metastatic rows split by PD-L1 status, and later lines.

verdicts.claim: The stage II-III row names neoadjuvant pembrolizumab with chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-522) and adjuvant olaparib for germline BRCA carriers with residual disease (OlympiA).
verdicts.note: Both trials are linked from the row and the ESMO-MCBS grades are given for each.

verdicts.claim: The record's own links list holds a single entry, Wikipedia.
verdicts.note: Guideline links live on the individual rows; a record-level link to the guideline or a registry would help a reader who skips the table.
